text:
maria: Heads-up — guest arriving at 3pm with a medium service dog and an oversized art parcel labeled 'ArtBox Co.' Any guidance on seating and where front desk should stash the parcel? :paw_prints: :package:
front-desk: Thanks Maria — we can hold the parcel behind the counter if it fits, otherwise we'll put it in the overflow locker A3. We have a wheelchair-accessible seating area near conference B if the guest needs it.
devon: If the dog claims the couch I'm filing a grievance :dog: it's my post-lunch nap spot.
jordan: Pro tip — label the parcel with "HOLD FOR MARIA" and the guest's name. We usually mark big deliveries with a sticky and photo it.
samira: Also, service animals can sit anywhere. If guest needs a low table, Facilities can bring over the small round table from the library.
tia: @front-desk can you confirm locker A3 code or process? We shouldn't post codes publicly.
front-desk: We'll use the secure locker process — it auto-generates a one-time code tied to the delivery ticket. I logged a hold tag: "Hold for maria (3pm guest)". We'll ping when it's picked up.
delivery-bot: Package 'ArtBox Co.' (1 of 1) logged as "hold" for recipient: Maria — ticket #6412.
maria: Thanks! Can someone check if the lounge couch is free at 2:45? I'll swing by with the guest to drop bags before meeting.
devon: I'll move my jacket. Also bringing treats for the pupper in case needed :treats: 
front-desk: Cool — we'll reserve the accessible seat by conference B. Locker A3 reserved under ticket #6412.
jordan: Quick question — should we flag the oversized parcel in the weekly inventory spreadsheet? It's going to storage if not picked up by Friday.
samira: Yes please. Add row: ArtBox Co. — oversized — hold — MARIA — pickup by Fri 5pm.
maria: Added to the spreadsheet, thanks everyone. See you at 3!
front-desk: Noted. Closing ticket when parcel is picked up. :white_check_mark:
